messages:
sec-bot: [auto] NEW VULN: CVE-2026-0001 - kms-client <=2.3.1 - remote key enumeration reported. Repo/PoC: https://github.com/example/kms-client/issues/123 :warning:

omar: saw this. initial triage: kms-client is used by Dedicated and some Private installs. Need customer version breakdown. @katie can you pull the mapping?

katie: running query now, will paste counts in a sec. if PoC is reliable we should assume high priority for private installs.

katie: query results:
- Hosted: 0 instances (we pin hosted runtime to 2.4.0)
- Dedicated: 28 customers on 2.3.1 (10 are high-traffic enterprise/Tier A)
- Private: manifests for 12 customers, 7 on 2.3.1 (we're missing telemetry for some air-gapped installs)
DMing ops team to reach remaining private contacts.

david: product perspective: if keys can be enumerated that's severe for compliance customers. Recommend treat as P1 for Dedicated + Private. Hosted looks low risk for now.

omar: agree. PoC seems reliable from initial review (simple unauth enumerations). I'm inclined to P1 for Dedicated/Private. SLA impact: potential data exposure -> SLA breach for Tier A.

liam: oncall availability: we have emergency window tonight 23:00-02:00 UTC. Recommend a staged canary: 10% -> 50% -> full. Need rollback plan.

katie: rollback is just redeploy previous image, no DB migrations. Owners: eng-runtime to cut build, eng-sre to run canary, sec to author advisory.

omar: proposed ops schedule:
```
- Tonight 23:00 UTC: 10% canary in us-east (Dedicated clusters)
- 03:00 UTC: if stable, expand to 50% (us-east + eu-west)
- 08:00 UTC: full rollout to all Dedicated pools
- Next Tue 16:00 UTC: targeted advisory + automated upgrade scripts for Private installs
```

david: communications: target Tier A customers immediately after canary success. If exploit attempts are observed, open public status incident. Avoid blog post until rollout complete.

katie: metrics/dashboards I'll add: auth_errors, kms.decrypt_latency, 5xx_rate, customer_key_access_count (new). Will add short-lived dashboard and alerts.

liam: adding alert: customer_key_access_count > baseline * 5 for 5m => page sec-oncall + eng-sre. Also alert on increase in 5xx_rate > 1% absolute.

omar: decision: classify as P1 for Dedicated & Private, P3 for Hosted. Patch merge ready? @matt any ETA on build?

matt: build in progress, smoke tests running. ETA ~90m. No schema/db changes. I'll publish image tag `kms-patch-196300` when done.

ben: I'll draft the Tier A advisory and coordinate with account teams. We should send targeted emails + support playbook for private customers. No public advisory until we confirm rollout.

omar: I'll open incident ticket INC-196300 and link this thread. Please add any playbook notes to the incident.

sec-bot: incident INC-196300 created by omar.

katie: after canary I'll run an automated upgrade on a non-critical Dedicated customer to validate post-deploy metrics. Assigning followups: matt (build/push), liam (canary execution), omar (sec signoff), ben (customer comms), katie (dashboards + runbook).

liam: noted. I will schedule canary run and add it to ops calendar.

ben: pinging account leads now to prepare for outreach if canary is successful.

omar: thanks everyone. Keep replies short here if you're on the critical path. We'll reconvene in #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
